lines.text: دیگر است ثابداست باینکه محرک فلک داخل خارج را بکدر وسعت و سخن اضعاف
lines.en: another is fixed, in that the mover of the inner sphere to the outer, in the amount of vastness and thickness of multiples

lines.text: اضعاف او باشد ممتنع مینماید و بران هیچ کواکب نیست و از اینجهت او را فلک غیر کوکب و
lines.en: of its multiples, appears impossible, and there are no stars on it, and for this reason it is called the starless sphere and

lines.text: فلک اطلس خوانند و چون محیط است بکل انرا فلک اعظم و فلک اعلی گویند و محرک سایر
lines.en: the atlas sphere, and since it encompasses the whole, they call it the greatest sphere and the highest sphere, and the mover of the other

lines.text: افلاکست انرا فلک الافلاک گویند و چون منتهای افلاک است انرا فلک قصی خوانند
lines.en: spheres, they call it the sphere of spheres, and since it is the end of the spheres, they call it the farthest sphere

lines.text: و چون غایت الابعاد است انرا محدد الجهات گویند و در عرف اهل شرع انرا عرش گویند
lines.en: and since it is the limit of distances, they call it the determiner of directions, and in the custom of the people of the law, they call it the throne

lines.text: و هر یک از افلاک ثمانیه مذکوره را حرکتی است از مغرب بمشرق مخالف حرکت فلک اعظم است
lines.en: and each of the mentioned eight spheres has a movement from west to east, contrary to the movement of the greatest sphere

lines.text: که آن را از مشرق بمغرب چنانکه نظر بدلیل دقیق بران دالست و چون بر وجه ابتداء از مغرب

summary.headline: The Ninth Sphere and Celestial Spheres
summary.text: Description of the ninth sphere, or sphere of spheres, including its names as the starless, atlas, greatest, highest, farthest, and throne sphere, its east-to-west motion, and the contrary west-to-east motion of the eight planetary spheres. The page introduces a diagram of the nine celestial spheres and four elemental spheres, from the sphere of fixed stars through Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, the Sun, Venus, Mercury, Moon, fire, air, water, and earth.
